args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_designation,
    (CASE 
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'None' THEN 10
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'Moderate' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.harmassess = 'Severe' THEN 1
    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Critical' THEN 1
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'High' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Low' THEN 10
    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Stable' THEN 10
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Moderate' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Unstable' THEN 1
    END) AS quality_index
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanconservation sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
ORDER BY 
    quality_index DESC;

Present the results in descending order of quality values, displaying only the site code, site designation, and calculated value to facilitate prioritization of our digital preservation resources.

You have a budget of 20.0 bird-coins. Use your tools to explore the database, clarify ambiguities with the user, and submit your final SQL efficiently.
